## New

- **The Updating note shows the download's progress.** The note above the pill reads "Updating to Murmur vX · N%" and fills green as the update downloads, then says "Restarting…" just before Murmur restarts to install it.
- **Opening the menu checks for an update.** Click the Murmur icon or right-click the pill, and Murmur looks for a new version in the background, at most every 5 minutes.
